mask_source: GT only, signed targets; native road; abs contrast>10 after sigma .7; area4..600; box<=60x35
signal_source: floating point model output, each method 120-frame median background removed; per-frame scalar road drift removed

valid_ROI.selection: straight driving lane traced on same-scene GT frame60, x>=350; excludes upper buildings and parked cars; previous polygon rejected after picture review
valid_ROI.offline_recenter: subtract per-frame median in corrected lane; no model or input changes

day_normal.limits: GT threshold-assisted evaluation, not human target annotations; road static statistic excludes target histories; whole-image quality not measured by this probe
